about: Golden stacks: items made by this release of the mod in a test server, read by UpgradeTests (docs/development.md, Golden stacks). Bytes: ItemStack.ToBytes, base64, with the numeric ids of the capture's world; Ids: the code of each of them. Inputs: what went into each item, the expected values. Attributes: for people only. Never edit or capture a set again.
